messages:
maya: Postmortem posted: intermittent cross-region LB retries + TLS handshakes during yesterday's rollout. Root cause summary: DNS negative cache + non-atomic SNI rotation. Need owners for follow-ups and a clear ETA. See notes PN-5075 and PN-5076.
rolf: I'll own DNS followups (PN-5080). Short term: bump negative_ttl to 12s and add immediate cache purge after rollout. PR ETA 24h.
anya: I'll take SNI rotation (PN-5081). Short-term mitigation: rotation lock and fallback to previous cert if rotation fails. Prototype in 48h.
chris: I'll handle observability (PN-5082). Adding per-region retry-rate, per-node TLS-failures, and a synthetic that validates SNI vs cert id every 1m. Alert if TLS failures >3% for 5m.
maya: Please paste ticket IDs and short runbooks here so I can include in the exec summary. Any customer-facing mitigations?
rolf: PN-5080 — dns-ttl-bump: change resolver.negative_ttl=12s, cache_clean_interval=20s, add canary in eu-west-1. Runbook: if retries persist, revert to previous resolver config.
anya: PN-5081 — sni-rotate-lock: add kv flag rotate_in_progress, require leader acquisition, fallback behavior -> keep old cert. Long-term: transactional rotate API.
chris: PN-5082 — alerts: pager if TLS-handshake-failures >3% OR cross-region retry ratio >6% for 5m. Runbook: pause rollout, clear caches, scale stable pool.
ops-bot: @maya Deploy freeze scheduled for the canary window and follow-up sync created at 2004004300. Will notify release-war-room.
maya: Owners recap for exec: Rolf -> PN-5080 (DNS) PR 24h, Anya -> PN-5081 (SNI) prototype 48h, Chris -> PN-5082 (alerts) 24h, Ops -> freeze + canary validation. I'll publish the action tracker once tickets are linked.
rolf: I'll attach the config diff in PN-5080: ```yaml
resolver:
  negative_ttl: 12
  cache_clean_interval: 20s
```
anya: Sample lock snippet I'll include in PN-5081. Will add feature flag for staged enable.
chris: Adding dashboards and runbooks now. Will link PN-5082 here.
ops-bot: Reminder: 24h status ping scheduled (2004004300) with [rolf, anya, chris, maya].
maya: Thanks everyone. Keep 12-24h updates in tickets and ping me if blockers come up.
